packs.title: A mood dial in GPT-2 small
packs.question: Does one direction, taken from happy-minus-angry sentences, push GPT-2's next word from 'terrible' towards 'great', how much per unit of push, and what does it break?
packs.headline: dose +1 shifts the metric by +7.86 against a random band of ±3.49

claims.text: Pushing along the direction at layer 6 (dose +1) shifts the metric by +7.857 (95% CI +7.186 to +8.479); 8 random directions of the same size shift it by at most 2.192. Loss on neutral text changes by +2.462 nats.

Pushing against the direction at layer 6 (dose -1) shifts the metric by -4.377 (95% CI -5.115 to -3.622); 8 random directions of the same size shift it by at most 2.318. Loss on neutral text changes by +2.639 nats.

packs.title: Does GPT-2 small know which city is in which country?
packs.question: Is "this sentence is true" written in a straight line inside GPT-2 small, and from which layer? (The same test as the Qwen 3.5 2B probe, on a model 16 times smaller.)
packs.headline: best layer 6: 98% held-out (shuffled-label control at most 79%)

claims.text: The label is linearly readable from the residual stream: at layer 6 a logistic probe gets 98% of held-out examples right (95% CI 93% to 100%), against 79% at best for probes trained and scored on shuffled labels.
It becomes readable by layer 5 of 12: earlier layers do not clear the control.
The simple difference-of-means direction at layer 6 gets 95% (CI 88% to 100%); it is saved for steering, which tests whether the model actually uses it.

packs.title: Where does GPT-2 small notice formal writing?
packs.question: Is formal-versus-casual written in a straight line inside GPT-2 small, from which layer, and how much easier is it to read than truth?
packs.headline: best layer 0: 100% held-out (shuffled-label control at most 71%)

claims.text: The label is linearly readable from the residual stream: at layer 0 a logistic probe gets 100% of held-out examples right (95% CI 100% to 100%), against 71% at best for probes trained and scored on shuffled labels.
It is readable from the first layer probed (layer 0 of 12).
The simple difference-of-means direction at layer 0 gets 100% (CI 100% to 100%); it is saved for steering, which tests whether the model actually uses it.
